sourceReasoning: WebGLShadowMap.getDepthMaterial uses its shared default MeshDepthMaterial for opaque source maps without alphaTest/clipped-shadow variants. It assigns result.map from each source material.
WebGLMaterials.refreshUniformsCommon only assigns uniforms.map when material.map is truthy. The shadow material can retain a previous map uniform after its current map becomes null.

The native leaked allocations bind map in the same shadow program as the removed bottle. The targeted material witness separately records that previous bottle Texture disposed once with width=0 while the shared shadow map uniform still references it.

Together these locate the repeated allocation at reuse of the shared shadow map sampler after the previous company instance has released its texture. Exact per-instance ownership of custom depth/distance materials is a bounded repair candidate for the root to implement and verify.
limitations: Read-only diagnosis. The runtime repair and its regression are owned by the root and remain outside this evidence.

Two exact eight-swap traces were collected, with two targeted single-transition attribution attempts in between. Neither single-transition attempt reproduced a new allocation, so timing sensitivity is preserved in the evidence.

The first diagnostic retained two allocations after renderer disposal. The sampler trace removed them at renderer disposal. Both retain the per-tissue allocations across all ordinary scene/cache swaps and additional draw frames.
Native ImageBitmaps close exactly once with no live decoded image after scene/cache disposal. This does not cover physical-GPU or ordinary-PC performance.
